dict.string: Persona lets Claude read and add calendar events when you ask, for example to check whether you are free on Friday afternoon or to book a meeting.
Persona adds events to your calendar when you ask Claude to, for example to save a meeting it scheduled for you.
Persona uses the camera to scan the pairing QR code printed by `personad hub pair`, for example when you first connect to your hub.
Persona lets Claude look up your contacts when you ask, for example to find a colleague's phone number or email before drafting a message.
Persona asks for Optic ID before it types a Mac's remembered password on that Mac's lock screen, when you tap One-Tap Unlock on the Mac's page.
Persona shares your current location with Claude only when you ask, for example to find what time it is where you are or which office you are in.

Persona records audio when you start a recording or dictate a message, for example a meeting or a spoken note. Recordings are transcribed on your device and only the text is saved to the knowledge base on your hub; the audio stays on your device.
Persona saves images Claude produces to your library when you ask, for example a chart it generated.
Persona lets Claude look at recent photos when you ask, for example to read a screenshot you took or describe a whiteboard photo.
Persona lets Claude read and create reminders when you ask, for example to add “review the PR” to your Today list.
Persona turns your voice into text when you hold the mic button, for example to dictate a reply to Claude.
